component.name: Beta Calendars Studio
component.summary: Offline calendar layouts and civil-date tools

description.p: Browse Gregorian month and year grids, inspect ISO weeks, check calendar geometry, and design blank printable calendars. Core date calculations and SVG exports run locally.
The optional resource library opens Beta Calendars pages only after the user selects a link. The application does not read personal calendars or send analytics or telemetry.
